countyPrograms.name: Bergen County Board of Social Services homemaker / certified home health aide
countyPrograms.eligibility: Residents age 60+ or disabled adults needing personal care at home. The county assesses financial and prospective JACC or MLTSS eligibility; there is a waiting list.
countyPrograms.benefit: Interim in-home personal-care help, coordinated at no charge for eligible participants.
countyPrograms.action: Call Bergen County Senior Services for screening and the waiting list.
